title: Harden package distribution, CI and reuse provenance
summary: Turn the reference package into a reproducible developer dependency with documented support and automated checks. Preserve source and license provenance for harvested components and keep qualification fixtures distinct from private data.
in_scope: Supported Python versions, package assets, CI matrix and reproducible build evidence.
Third-party source/license inventory and dependency update checks.
out_of_scope: Deploying or modifying a downstream project as part of this planning ticket without that implementation task.
Treating synthetic checks as evidence of live provider or user outcomes.
implementation: Extend the scaffold checks to production schemas, runtime tests, public conformance fixtures and packaging installation from built artifacts.
Record exact reused components, licenses, local adaptations and upstream versions.
Verify installation and operation from a clean environment without accidental checkout-only dependencies or private files.

acceptance.criterion: The built artifact contains all promised public schemas and runs supported operations outside the source checkout.
acceptance.verification: Build and install in a fresh environment and execute documented SDK examples against packaged assets.

acceptance.criterion: CI catches a broken ticket graph, contract regression and dependency compatibility failure.
acceptance.verification: Introduce controlled mutations in a temporary test branch or local workflow equivalent and record the expected failing checks.

acceptance.criterion: The distribution excludes private corpus material, credentials and unreviewed copied source.
acceptance.verification: Inspect archive contents and compare the source/license manifest to every vendored or adapted component.

tests: Unsupported Python version and absent optional provider dependency.
Dependency upgrade changes response validation behavior.
risks: A passing checkout test can conceal missing package assets.
Upstream license or interface changes can invalidate a reuse assumption.

reuse.application: Preserve the explicit scope, provenance, qualification, and evidence boundaries in the governing contracts.
